## Price

The programme costs **$4225 per person**. Minimum group size: 4 people.

## Life in the wilderness

The Amazon basin contains the world’s largest expanse of moist tropical forest. This trip gives you hands-on experience of life in the jungle. Instead of conventional sightseeing, you learn techniques you can use far from civilisation and put them straight into practice.
